postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Ubuntu 16.15-0ubuntu0.24.04.1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0, 64-bit

orm.prepared_statements: engine default: prepared once per connection and cached
orm.insert_note: monorm returns full rows: insertMany(...).returning() has no key-only form
orm.upsert_note: onConflict returns a row count, no RETURNING

prisma.query_engine: TypeScript query compiler (WASM) with the driver adapter; no Rust query engine
prisma.prepared_statements: unnamed statements: the pg driver re-parses each call (adapter-pg without statementNameGenerator)
prisma.insert_note: bulk inserts use createManyAndReturn with select { id: true }: ids only, monorm returns full rows
prisma.upsert_note: upsert-100 is 100 upserts in one $transaction: Prisma has no bulk upsert, monorm and Django send one statement
prisma.find_unique_note: findUnique calls in one tick are batched by Prisma into one query; this runner issues them one at a time
prisma.update_note: update-1 uses updateMany (no row read back); update() would add a SELECT

drizzle.prepared_statements: Drizzle default: unnamed statements, no prepare (`.prepare(name)` is opt-in)
drizzle.relation_note: join-to-one, prefetch-to-many and m2m use relational queries (db.query): one SQL statement with json subqueries per relation
drizzle.insert_note: bulk-insert-* returns ids only (`returning({ id })`), as Prisma and pg do

pg.prepared_statements: named prepared statements, one name per statement text
pg.join_note: join-to-one uses an inner JOIN: posts.author_id is NOT NULL, so the rows equal the ORMs' joins

orm-all.prepared_statements: engine default: prepared once per connection and cached
orm-all.insert_note: monorm returns full rows: insertMany(...).returning() has no key-only form
orm-all.upsert_note: onConflict returns a row count, no RETURNING
